svg.aria-label: Clickable figure, axes, and display spaces

rect.data-explain: Figure space: fig.text(x, y, …) and subplots_adjust use this. Title x comes from a bbox converted with fig.transFigure.inverted().
Axes space: set_label_coords(x, y) defaults to this. (0,1) is the top-left of the data rectangle. The y-label is shifted until its top (y1) hits 1.0.

circle.data-explain: Display space: get_window_extent returns pixels. You almost never leave numbers here — BaseChart always inverted()-transforms them back to axes or figure.
